analysis_exclusion_policy.description: Duopoly cases where any AI model or the standard heuristic recommendation has negative raw ground-truth demand are retained in the source data but excluded from app analyses. Regression Heuristic keeps its own infeasible-fit rule and does not define the case-level exclusion set.
